newsitem.title: USA: Littelfuse sees record year in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Littelfuse sees record year in 1997.

text.p: Littelfuse Inc said Thursday it expects record results in 1997.
In 1996, the manufacturer of electronic, power and automotive fuses earned $1.81 a share on sales of $241.4 million.

"We'll benefit from the continued introduction of new products, including new surface mount and resettable products," Howard Witt, chairman, said in a statement. "We'll also continue to consider making acquisitions when the conditions are right. We expect 1997 to be another record year."
Earlier, Littelfuse reported second quarter earnings of $0.29 a share, up from $0.23 a year ago, adjusted for a two-for-one stock split completed on June 10, 1997.
"We achieved solid increases in our two major product lines and all of our geographic markets," Witt said.
